picks.title: YouTube Music launches new labels as AI-generated music floods streaming platforms
picks.rationale: The biggest music platform starts labeling AI tracks on the player page, both fully and partly generated. Concrete platform policy that affects every artist releasing music; best of a 4-outlet cluster.
picks.excerpt: The label will appear on the player page and include songs entirely generated by AI or partially, such as AI involved in composition and vocals.

picks.title: discoDSP releases WavePrompt, a FREE AI music generation app for macOS and Windows
picks.rationale: A free standalone text-to-music desktop app for producers, new this week. Directly usable tomorrow.
picks.excerpt: From developer discoDSP comes WavePrompt, a free AI music generation app for macOS and Windows that brings the text-to-music approach to a standalone desktop tool for producers.

picks.title: Taylor Swift expands voice trademark filings to the UK, EU, and Australia amid AI deepfake crackdown
picks.rationale: New filings that extend voice-as-trademark protection against AI deepfakes to three more jurisdictions. A concrete legal step other artists may copy.
picks.excerpt: Taylor Swift has extended filings to trademark her voice to the UK, EU and Australia, following three applications submitted to the USPTO in April, as artists seek tools against AI voice deepfakes.

picks.title: Raye says ticket scalpers used AI bots to create 'hundreds of thousands of fake registrations' as 1.8M sign up for 5,000 Royal Albert Hall seats
picks.rationale: AI-bot fraud moves from streaming to live ticketing: hundreds of thousands of fake presale registrations. A fresh angle on AI abuse that touches fan marketing.
picks.excerpt: Presale registration for the Royal Albert Hall show, run through fan marketing platform co:brand, was flooded by AI-bot sign-ups; her team is now manually reviewing registrations.

dedup.note: DROPPED as same story: Engadget + TechCrunch 'Deezer will let listeners filter out AI music' (c5). Both cover the same Deezer AI-filter announcement already published 10-14 as MBW 'Deezer to let users block AI-generated music from search results'. The TechCrunch rollout timing ('by end of year') is extra reporting, not a new release. Music Ally 10-13 'Deezer lets users hide AI music; Playhead generates signal chains' was also dropped: the Deezer half is the 10-14 story and the Playhead half is the product published 09-19 (BPB playhead-custom-effects). Suno 'Albums, Speech...' YouTube video was dropped because Suno albums ran 10-06 and Suno speech ran 10-03. CLUSTER c1 (YouTube Music AI labels): kept TechCrunch and dropped The Verge, Engadget and MBW as the same event. This is a new story, distinct from the 09-24 conversational-features piece. Diversity: 4 outlets (TechCrunch, BPB, MBW x2, Music Ally); same category, so each pick gets its own palette accent. SWAP (post-enrichment): removed pick 5, Music Ally 'Audiotool reveals six winners from its Let's Build! hackathon'. The fact-check found it is a general hackathon write-up where only 2 of 6 winners use AI, so it fails the AI-relevance test. Replacement: the Rocketship launch from the Music Ally 10-14 'Today in Music AI news' roundup. Rocketship is a new AI pre-release audience-profiling tool. Nearest published stories are a different company in the same niche: HumanCulture predictive intelligence (10-08) and Base for Music marketing-ROI AI (10-09). Neither covers Rocketship, so the verdict is new. Constraint for the writer: write about Rocketship only, because the roundup's Raye item duplicates pick 4. Other options rejected: (1) JTBC 'AI music on the charts' (10-11) is a feature on the same AI-song-tops-chart event published 10-05 (isplus) and adds no new event. (2) Dan Kieft 'Suno v6 + Seedance 2.5' is a creator tutorial, not a release; Suno v6 already ran 09-18/09-22/09-28, and the source is low-credibility. (3) Billboard Blackburn AI Kendrick video is about social-media backlash to a politician's post. It is AI-relevant, but there is no actionable release, and it fits politics better than music tools. MBW stays at 2 picks, and the outlet count stays at 4 with Music Ally replacing Music Ally. | ORCHESTRATOR 2026-10-15: Rocketship replacement dropped after enrichment — its public beta opened 2026-05-16; the 10-14 roundup reports no new event, so it fails freshness.
